agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, October 28, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular Meeting held on October 14, 2015.
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2015-49 Approving the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Award of a Professional Services Agreement to John L. Hunter & Associates, Inc. in the amount of $41,020 for Stormwater Compliance and Environmental Engineering Services
ACTION: Authorize the Interim City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement with John L. Hunter & Associates, Inc. in the amount of $41,020.
Item #7d
e.
Consideration of Salary Schedule assignments and revisions to Class Specifications
Res 2015-50 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita amending Resolution No. 2015-33, a resolution establishing a compensation plan for employees for fiscal year commencing July 1, 2015 and ending June 30, 2016.
That the City Council approve the following:
a)
Replace the Accounting Supervisor position with a new Accounting Manager classification and assign Salary Schedule No. 85 to the Accounting Manager classification; and
b)
Assign Salary Schedule No. 76 to the Associate Planner classification; and
c)
Assign Salary Schedule No. 72 to the Assistant Planner classification and authorize the City Manager to fill the current Planning Division vacancy at the Assistant Planner level;
ACTION: Adopt the resolution; adopt the changes as stated above; approve the Accounting Manager classification specification; and approve revisions to the Class Specifications as outlined in the staff report.
Item #7e
PUBLIC HEARINGS:
8.
CONSIDERATION OF SITE PLAN REVIEW NO. 1157 AND VESTING TENTATIVE PARCEL MAP NO. 72623 FOR A NEW THREE UNIT RESIDENTIAL CONDOMINIUM PROJECT
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Res 2015-50 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving Vesting Tentative Parcel Map No. 72623 and Site Plan Review No. 1157 for the subdivision of property located at 21409 Alliene Avenue in the RVD-2500 Zone. (Filed by Shahab Sara, LLC c/o Abbas Mirrrashidi, 541 Via Almar, Palos Verdes Estates.)
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving Site Plan Review Plan No. 1157 and Vesting Tentative Parcel Map No. 72623 to allow a new three-unit residential condominium project on an 8,400 square foot lot zone RVD-2500, Residential Variable Density, located at 24109 Alliene Avenue.
Item #8
9.
AN ORDINANCE ADOPTING THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY BUILDING CODE WHICH HAS A NEW CHAPTER 68 ESTABLISHING A STREAMLINED PERMITTING PROCESS FOR RESIDENTIAL SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEMS
Presented by Principal Planner Velasco
Ord. 775 - An Ordinance of the City of Lomita, Code Amendment No. 2015-03, to amend Section 10-1.01 (County Building Code Adopted) to adopt by reference the current version of Title 26 of the Los Angeles County Code including new Chapter 68, expedited permitting for small residential rooftop solar energy systems. (First Reading)
ACTION: Introduce first reading of an ordinance adopted by reference Title 26 of the Los Angeles County Building Code; and direct staff to schedule a second reading and adoption of Ordinance on November 10, 2015, Council meeting, in accordance with California Government Code, Title 5, Division1, Part 1, as required by the Building Standards Commission.
Item #9
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
10.
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION REGARDING AN ENERGY EFFICIENCY CHAPTER OF THE CITY'S CLIMATE ACTION PLAN
Presented by SBCCOG and Atkins staff
Res. 2015-51 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, approving the Energy Efficiency Chapter of the City's Climate Action Plan.
ACTION: Adopt the attached Resolution approving the energy efficiency chapter of the City's Climate Action Plan.
Item #10
11.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE DIRECTION REGARDING THE TEUCHERT PROPERTY AT 1845 WEST 260TH STREET
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano
ACTION: Direct staff to solicit requests for proposals (RFPs) for park design; develop a public outreach process; and return to City Council at a future date to award the park design contract.
Item #11
12.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be an Adjourned Regular Meeting on Tuesday, November 10, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
e.
Consideration of Salary Schedule assignments and revisions to Class Specifications
Res 2015-50 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita amending Resolution No. 2015-33, a resolution establishing a compensation plan for employees for fiscal year commencing July 1, 2015 and ending June 30, 2016.
That the City Council approve the following:
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
